Definition: properly, removal; used only (in the construction) adverb as conjunction, lest
BiblicalUsage: Pen means lest, that not — the little word that guards a fear. Saul told his armourbearer to thrust him through, lest the uncircumcised come and abuse him, and the Philistines urged each other to fight, that they be not servants to the Hebrews.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that “lest” is the word of a heart that knows what it fears: Saul feared abuse, and the Philistines feared slavery — and fear drove them both.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
